parameters.content:
## TOPIC PICKER (moi ngay)

KHONG con phu thuoc mot minh vietstock.vn. Tim chu de TAM LY HOC hoac
DAU TU TAI CHINH qua Tavily, chon 5 chu de/ngay (tron 2 nhom), moi chu
de se thanh 1 video rieng (xem Loop Over Headlines ben duoi).

Dung pattern DETERMINISTIC (Code build query -> httpRequest Tavily truc
tiep -> Code digest -> LLM tool-free) thay vi agent+tool ReAct, vi agent
+tool voi Ollama local da tung bi lap vo han 'Max iterations reached' o
workflow khac trong repo nay.

return [{ json: { ...$json, topicsQuery: query } }];

## PER-VIDEO PIPELINE (chay 1 lan / chu de, trong Loop Over Headlines)

Video dai muc tieu 90-120 giay (~2 phut, van trong gioi han Shorts cua
YouTube la <=3 phut). Research Agent + Screen Planner giu nguyen kien
truc agent+tool cu (chua thay loi trong workflow that), chi cap nhat
prompt de tong quat hoa ngoai tin tuc tai chinh (them tam_ly).

parameters.content:
## DANG THEM FACEBOOK REELS + TIKTOK (2026-07-27)

Ca 2 nhanh nay chay SONG SONG voi nhanh YouTube (deu bat dau tu 'Prepare
YouTube Metadata'), va deu dung onError=continueRegularOutput tren MOI
node - neu Facebook hoac TikTok loi (token het han, rate limit, v.v.) thi
CHI nhanh do bi anh huong, KHONG lam crash ca video/ca ngay chay.

FACEBOOK: can Page Access Token (dan vao FB_ACCESS_TOKEN trong Load
Config) + FB_PAGE_ID (da dien san). Luu y: token nguoi dung dan vao chat
TRUOC DAY DA BI LO - PHAI xoay vong (rotate) token moi truoc khi dung.

TIKTOK: client_key/client_secret KHONG du de dang video - TikTok bat
buoc phai co access_token/refresh_token cua NGUOI DUNG THAT qua man hinh
dong y OAuth. Chay 1 LAN DUY NHAT script `tiktok_oauth_setup.py` (dung
trang callback tinh docs/tiktok-callback.html tren GitHub Pages - khong
can ngrok/server local) de tao ra tiktok_tokens.json. Workflow se tu dong
REFRESH token truoc moi lan dang (khong can lam lai buoc OAuth thu cong
nay nua tru khi refresh_token het han sau 365 ngay). App unaudited -> chi
dang duoc SELF_ONLY (rieng tu) - doi TIKTOK_PRIVACY_LEVEL trong Load
Config sau khi TikTok duyet app de dang cong khai.
